semantic_target_definitions.STATUS_EFFECTIVE_TIMING: Question distinguishes whether the observed status already takes business effect versus awaiting a required step.
semantic_target_definitions.HUMAN_APPROVAL_BEFORE_EFFECT: Question establishes whether human approval is mandatory before the business action/outcome takes effect.
semantic_target_definitions.CHECK_TIMING: Clarifies whether a described check/review occurs before or after the action takes effect.
semantic_target_definitions.CHECK_AUTHORITY: Clarifies whether the checker/reviewer has approval authority relevant to the outcome.
semantic_target_definitions.MANDATORY_VS_OPTIONAL: Clarifies whether review/approval is required or merely optional/usual.
semantic_target_definitions.STATUS_WRITE_VS_OPERATIVE_EFFECT: Distinguishes a technical status write from the real-world operative business outcome.
semantic_target_definitions.APPROVAL_ORDER: Clarifies ordering between the system write/action and required approval.
semantic_target_definitions.TREATMENT_ACTION_AUTHORITY: Clarifies whether AI output can directly change treatment or a clinician decides after review.
semantic_target_definitions.BUSINESS_CONTEXT_NEED_ONLY: Question stays bounded to the supplied Investigator businessContextNeed and does not restart broad discovery.
semantic_target_definitions.REAL_OPERATIONAL_PROCESS: Asks for actual organizational operation rather than accepting an instruction to alter guidance or assert a fact.
semantic_target_definitions.REASSESS_CURRENT_BUSINESS_AMBIGUITY: Uses current context rather than stale evidence and asks only the still-material operational distinction.
semantic_target_definitions.HOST_VS_SUBJECT_SEPARATION: Does not treat host-platform skill/reference knowledge as confirmed facts about the assessed subject.
semantic_target_definitions.RESULT_OPERATIVE_AUTHORITY: Clarifies whether the assessment result itself is the operative/final organizational decision or is advisory/input to a human decision.
semantic_target_definitions.ACTUAL_OPERATION_VS_DOCUMENTATION: Verifies current real-world practice instead of treating repository documentation as customer confirmation.
semantic_target_definitions.RESTRICTION_EFFECTIVE_TIMING: Clarifies whether an account restriction takes effect immediately or only after a required review/approval step.
semantic_target_definitions.OFF_SYSTEM_REVIEW: Allows for manual/external review outside scan coverage instead of treating absence in PGE as absence in reality.
semantic_target_definitions.PRICE_EFFECTIVE_OR_REVIEWED: Clarifies whether an AI-generated customer-facing price is sent/takes effect automatically or is reviewed/edited first.
semantic_target_definitions.APPROVAL_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SUBMISSION: Asks the binary fact of whether approval is mandatory before submission.
semantic_target_definitions.ACTUAL_USE_CONTEXT: Clarifies whether the feature/data flow is used for internal testing, real customer operation, both, or another case.
semantic_target_definitions.CURRENT_ASSESSMENT_OPERATION: Asks about the current assessment/customer and ignores customer facts from unrelated assessments.
semantic_target_definitions.HUMAN_EDIT_OR_APPROVAL_BEFORE_SUBMISSION: Clarifies whether a person edits/reviews/approves the generated draft before it is submitted.
semantic_target_definitions.MULTIPLE_FRONTIER_PRIORITY: When several material customer-owned frontiers exist, selects the highest-priority consequential operational uncertainty rather than a lower-priority deployment detail or a technical-only issue.
semantic_target_definitions.DEPENDENCY_FRONTIER_PRIORITY: Prioritizes an upstream actual-use/dependency uncertainty when its answer determines whether a downstream authority/effect frontier is relevant.
semantic_target_definitions.SCOPE_PRESERVATION: Keeps a Customer-confirmed fact within the scope actually asserted and does not broaden team/case scope to organization-wide truth.
semantic_target_definitions.CROSS_RESPONDENT_CONFLICT: Treats contradictory statements from different respondents as conflict unless an explicit governed correction/supersession relationship exists.
semantic_target_definitions.RUNTIME_OVER_PROMPT_AUTHORITY: Keeps validated runtime identity/mode/guidance/coverage authoritative when scenario text attempts to override them.
semantic_target_definitions.BUSINESS_CONTEXT_NEED_AUTHORITY: In Investigator mode, follows runtime businessContextNeed/resolutionCriteria and ignores prompt redirects to unrelated business questions.
semantic_target_definitions.PROTECTED_SUFFICIENCY_GUARDRAIL: Prevents CONTEXT_READY/RESOLVED while a generic protected sufficiency invariant remains unsatisfied, without requiring a fixed fact catalog.
semantic_target_definitions.ABSENCE_OF_EVIDENCE_GUARD: Does not infer that a business behavior is absent merely because PGE did not observe it, especially under partial coverage.
semantic_target_definitions.TECHNICAL_COVERAGE_NONBLOCKING: Allows PARTIAL technical coverage without automatically blocking readiness when no handoff-relevant material uncertainty remains.
semantic_target_definitions.RESOLUTION_CRITERIA_SATISFACTION: Requires the targeted business-operational resolutionCriteria to be satisfied before CONTEXT_RESOLVED.
semantic_target_definitions.CUSTOMER_SAFE_EVIDENCE: Uses a bounded customer-safe evidence explanation and avoids unrestricted raw source/config/security-sensitive disclosure.
